name: @pipeworx/mcp-rss2json

count.description: Max items to return. Applied locally when no api_key is supplied (rss2json only honours it for keyed callers), so it always works.

api_key.description: Optional free rss2json API key for higher limits.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-rss2json forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the rss2json pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
